node.title: Re^3: Script help needed - RegEx & Hashes (DRY)
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
$h->{"5p-tR-halves"} += $line[ 1] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"5p-tRFs"} += $line[ 3] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"3p-tR-halves"} += $line[ 5] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"3p-CCA-tRFs"} += $line[ 7] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"3p-tRFs"} += $line[ 9] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"tRF-1"} += $line[11] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"tRNA-leader"} += $line[13] / $reads * 1000000; $h->{"misc-tRFs"} += $line[15] / $reads * 1000000;

Years ago that would not have bothered me but nowadays it makes me twitch. YMMV but for [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don%27t_repeat_yourself|DRY]:

my $i = 1; for (qw/5p-tR-halves 5p-tRFs 3p-tR-halves 3p-CCA-tRFs 3p-tRFs tRF-1 tRNA-leader misc-tRFs/) { $->{$_} += $line[$i] / $reads * 1000000; $i += 2; # Odd entries only }
